title: Roveia pinned hero card
description: An inset hero card washed from white to pale blue, rounded 40px at the bottom: a centred two-line 70px light headline with blue words, a stat · 16:9 media · copy-and-blue-pill row, and a row of partners in white discs. On desktop it pins for a window while the media grows to fill the card, a dark veil fades in and the text turns light.
notes: desktop: 210svh tall (the card is pinned for 1.1 windows); phones: content height, no motion
the media slot is 16:9 with a 24px radius; the grow is a uniform scale, so a real video zooms
CSS scroll-driven animation only; static (everything in place) without support or with reduced motion
the text turns to primary-foreground over the media: best when that is light
name: roveia-hero

props.name: headline
props.description: the headline, in parts; highlighted parts are blue

props.name: description
props.description: the short line beside the media (desktop) or under the headline (phones)

props.name: stat
props.type: { icon?: ReactNode; value: string; label: string; note?: string; }

props.name: media
